title: Carry typed ACP tool lifecycle events through existing turn recording and v1 output
goal: Vision: V-6. Preserve legacy ACP executor and wire APIs while exposing typed official v1 tool call lifecycle for the coordinated session MCP bridge; provider continuation and full ACP compliance remain separate.

reuse.searched: Existing AcpTurnExecutor owned-cancel adapter, AcpEngine record_event sequencer, legacy rich output metadata/history/receipt, v1 Output and cancellation/backpressure fixtures; official ACP source13b7658/schema e747a7 pinned in private audit; root scoped tools/evidence/progress audit.
reuse.reason: Add a defaulted typed callback and translate within existing stream rather than replace executor APIs or introduce a global event bus. Bridge owner owns bounded queue and trusted tool observer; no new dependency or imported schema/source.

coordination: Agreed exact public types and execute_turn_with_events signature with acp_mcp_design. Parent integrates only with wired root observer/queue; no isolated public API publication.
limits: No additional authority or credential-bearing metadata in minimal tool event structs.
Cancellation tool status is failed with explicit cancellation text; no invalid cancelled status.
Schema validation is actual emitted wire sample shape checking, not full ACP certification.
Legacy public non-Send callback/transport bounds, rich output metadata/history and receipts remain unchanged.

validation.format: cargo fmt -p susi-gawd-acp --check and git diff --check passed

schema_actual_wire.limitation: Actual focused transport with fake executors; actual root CLI bridge validation remains separately owned. Not full ACP certification.

validation.independent_review: review_gemi read-only source/test review found no blockers; root queue lifetime/bounds and terminal flush remain separately reviewed.

source_delta.note: Correctness addition; no source reduction claim, test movement/deletion or dependency changes.

integration_result: Scoped implementation accepted on integrated0.21.71 development tree and remote-verified on main. Parent actual CLI10, affected units, SHA1 parity, workspace/lint/boundaries and live27pass2skip recorded. Complete307809-line and full-standards goal remain open.
